opening.argument: The video shows a practical walkthrough of Twitch mobile streaming. The speaker says they will show viewers where to find the feature and how to use it, and the setup screen shows a stream title field, an IRL category, and a START STREAM button. The demonstration then moves through saving the title and starting a stream. These are instructions for operating a platform feature, not a deceptive financial mechanism. Channel-support and affiliate-link disclosures remain separate monetization context; they do not change what the walkthrough shows. The record supports an instructional reading without claiming any financial loss, hidden intent, or outcome beyond the demonstrated steps.
